kernel: compress (device helpers colorSums, bestFitLine, sortColors, loadColorBlock inlined)

sites.source: sums[idx] += sums[idx ^ 8];   // the load of sums[idx ^ 8]

thread_pair_example: block 0, driver 32x32 image (64 blocks of 64 threads), only lanes 0-15 of warp 0 (idx < 16) run loadColorBlock: thread 0 writes sums[0] (L70) while thread 8 reads sums[8 ^ 8] = sums[0] (L71); the next lines (L72-L74: ^4, ^2, ^1) repeat the shape. Other racing pairs of the same block (all lanes 0-15, no barrier): covariance fill L88-L93 vs the tree reduction L99-L104 (the __syncthreads at L95 and L106 are commented out); L99-L104 vs the reads of covariance[0..5] by all lanes in firstEigenVector (L110); dps[idx] write L170 vs sortColors read L131; ranks write L134 vs reads L138; tmp = colors[idx] (L176) vs colors[xrefs[idx]] = tmp (L178).
class_reason: plain shared accesses (float3 members, float, int) by different lanes of one warp, no __syncwarp and no barrier between the write and the read (the lock-step assumption of pre-Volta CUDA): unordered conflicting plain accesses, DR under independent thread scheduling.
buggy_expected: the pair write L70 -> read L71 (and L71-L74 chain, the covariance L88-L104 chain, dps L170->L131, ranks L134->L138, colors L176->L178) is reported as DR (intra-warp RAW/WAR on sums[], covariance[], dps[], xrefs[], colors[]), lanes 0-15 of warp 0 only.

residual_sites.source: colors[xrefs[idx]] = colors[idx];   // fixed file; the load colors[idx]
colors[xrefs[idx]] = colors[idx];   // fixed file; the store colors[xrefs[idx]] of another lane

fixed.reason: the fix (6e11c2bb) inlines the helpers into compress() with cg::sync(cta) between all phases (load, sum by thread 0, covariance fill, tree reduction, eigenvector/dps, rank, tie-resolution), so the colorSums, covariance, dps and rank pairs of the buggy build are absent. The scatter colors[xrefs[idx]] = colors[idx] (fixed L448, the buggy L176-L178) is unchanged: lane j reads colors[j] while lane i writes colors[xrefs[i] = j] with no barrier between the read phase and the write phase, so a strict PTX detector may still report one intra-warp DR pair (lanes 0-15); hardware racecheck output cannot confirm (the issue-133 log saturated at the hazard limit). Residual risk for the fixed ground truth (verify.expected_report_fixed).

sass_notes: sm_89 SASS of the shipped build (sassline.sh, nvdisasm -g), buggy: L70 = 3x STS [R0+0x600], [R0+0x604], [R0+0x608] (0x0260, 0x0280, 0x0290), L71 = 3x LDS [R9+0x600..0x608] (0x02a0-0x02c0), L72 LDS 0x0330-0x0350, L73 0x03c0-0x03e0, L74 0x0450-0x0470; covariance fill L89/L91/L93 STS.64 (0x0590, 0x05a0, 0x05b0), tree reduction L99-L104 LDS/STS (0x05d0-0x0ad0, 4 unrolled steps); the first BAR.SYNC of the kernel (cg::sync, sm_30_intrinsics.hpp:99) is only at 0x2140, i.e. after all of loadColorBlock; there is no WARPSYNC and no BAR between L70 and 0x2140. All shared accesses are plain LDS/STS (LDS.128/STS.64 for float3 pieces), no .STRONG token. Fixed build: BAR.SYNC after every phase (first at 0x0240); L448 = LDS [R13], LDS [R5+0x380..0x388] (0x2b30-0x2b70) then STS [R7+0x380..0x388] (0x2b90-0x2bb0), plain, no sync between.

review.notes: Checked at fe80f0f: compress runs with NUM_THREADS=64 (main.cu:46, :698); loadColorBlock (main.cu:147-180) works under if (idx < 16) with no barrier or __syncwarp; the first cg::sync is at main.cu:481, after the call at :479. L70 sums[idx] = colors[idx] and L71 sums[idx] += sums[idx ^ 8] give the RAW thread 0 -> thread 8; the other listed chains (L71-L74, L88-L93 vs L99-L104 with //__syncthreads() at L95/L106, firstEigenVector(covariance) at L110, dps L170 -> L131, ranks L134 -> L138/L139, colors L176 -> L178) have the same shape. All plain shared arrays (main.cu:86, 153, 475-477). Fixed 6e11c2b: everything is inlined into compress (main.cu:360-470) with cg::sync after every phase (:383, :391, :404, :415, :426, :437, :444, :450); the scatter colors[xrefs[idx]] = colors[idx] at :448 has no barrier between the loads and the stores, and after the tie resolution (:440-445) xrefs is a permutation, so lane j loads colors[j] while lane i with xrefs[i] = j stores it: the residual intra-warp DR (lanes 0-15) holds by source. sass_notes are the builder's: the reviewer read sources and diffs only and did not re-dump SASS (the one srun queued with an estimated start the next day and was withdrawn).
